title: Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d)
description: About Us Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform combining commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX and spend management for businesses and AI agents. Businesses across travel, e-commerce, insurance and AI-native technology use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows, while fintechs, software platforms and banks use its infrastructure to build and operate their own commercial payment offerings. Pliant's API-first platform also enables AI agents and applications to access regulated payment infrastructure with permissions, controls and auditability built in. Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves businesses and partners across Europe and North America. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries under its European e-money license and through regulated partners in the UK and US. Learn more at www.getpliant.com. About The Role We are looking for an exceptional working student to join our team — someone who wants to build expertise in fintech and banking, sharpen their analytical skills, and work alongside senior specialists on critical operational risk topics. As a Working Student – Compliance Automation & AI (m/f/d) , you’ll sit at the intersection of fintech, data, and operational risk management. You’ll work on high-impact tasks in client onboarding, risk profiling, and transaction surveillance — while leveraging data-driven applications, Python, and AI tools to enhance efficiency and insight. You’ll collaborate closely with our Compliance, Risk, Product, and Engineering teams, gaining hands-on experience in one of Europe’s fastest-scaling fintechs. This role is Berlin-based with the ability to work at least 2 days per week from our Berlin HQ. What You’ll Do Onboarding, Risk & Transaction Surveillance Verify corporate clients (KYB), identifying legal representatives and beneficial owners through global databases and registries. Assess customer risk profiles using structured data, defined frameworks, and regulatory guidelines. Review AML alerts from monitoring systems, flag anomalies, and escalate potential cases to senior specialists. Analyze transaction patterns to detect suspicious behaviors or potential financial crime indicators. Prepare and maintain accurate digital credit files in compliance with internal policies. Contribute to the refinement of detection rules to reduce false positives and improve monitoring effectiveness. Data & Technology Integration Work with data-driven applications to support decision-making in compliance and monitoring. Use Python for data analysis, workflow automation, and reporting. Develop and maintain local LLM-based applications. Apply prompt engineering to accelerate research, document drafting, and case analysis. Process Innovation Collaborate with Product and Engineering to improve tools, workflows, and system logic. Suggest automation opportunities and AI-driven enhancements. What You’ll Bring Enrolled in a university program in computer science, data science, business informatics, engineering, or a related quantitative field, with a strong academic track record. Hands-on automation experience (n8n, Make, Zapier, or code-based pipelines), including API integrations. Proficiency in Python and SQL. Practical experience with LLMs and prompt engineering. Structured, detail-oriented, and disciplined about testing and documenting what you build. Fluent in English; German or other European languages are a plus. Nice to have Interest in fintech and curiosity about compliance topics such as AML/KYC and sanctions screening. Regulatory knowledge is not required; you'll learn it on the job. Experience with data analysis, visualization, or BI tools such as Metabase. Experience with Taktile or other rules engines, or with KYB/registry/Google Maps APIs. Familiarity with Git and AI coding tools such as Claude Code. What We Offer The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence Attractive remuneration Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals Flexibility and possibility to work remotely Monthly mobility benefit Wellhub Membership Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and abilities, and are committed to an inclusive hiring process. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know. At Pliant we use the Ashby AI Criteria to assist with looking over resumes against our job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by our Talent Team and Hiring Team. A human is behind these processes. Ashby does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our teams review all results and make the final hiring decision with every candidate that applies.

title: Working Student (f/m/d) – Product Management for SAP Business AI
description: Job Description What you’ll bring You're a student ready to contribute alongside your studies. You're curious, adapt quickly, and stay resilient as priorities evolve. You think creatively, communicate clearly, and collaborate well across teams. You're building your foundations in business and AI — and you take initiative to apply them. You bring emotional intelligence and cultural awareness to every interaction. You are enrolled at a university or university of applied sciences, preferably in a master’s programme in Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering and Management, Media Informatics, Information Systems or a related field combining business and technology Previous working-student or internship experience in product management, product owner support or technical project coordination is an advantage. Relevant university or personal projects can also demonstrate your skills You have a basic understanding of generative AI, large language models and AI agents, and practical experience using AI assistants for research, summaries or analysis. You can refine prompts, check results against sources and recognize when human review is needed You bring basic programming or scripting skills, preferably Python, and an interest in building small automations for tasks such as collecting project updates or preparing reports. Experience with Git, APIs or AI-assisted prototypes is an advantage You organize information, identify gaps and dependencies, and follow up on agreed actions. You write clear summaries for technical and business audiences. You can explain a workflow, write a short guide and gather feedback to understand whether a tool helps its users Your English is at B2 level or higher, written and spoken; German is an advantage. You can work from our Potsdam office once a week on Wednesdays What You’ll Build You'll work on real deliverables, not shadow tasks. Your contributions connect directly to your team's goals. You'll leave with a portfolio of SAP work you can build on. In this role, you will support product management in AI Foundation and develop AI tools for planning, research and reporting. Collect input from engineers, architects and other stakeholders. Structure requirements and open questions so the team can prepare decisions and agree next steps Support Product Owners with backlog refinement and quarterly planning. Keep milestones, dependencies and progress visible so teams can identify gaps and coordinate delivery Prepare meetings, workshops and stakeholder updates. Record decisions and follow up with owners so agreed actions move forward Help improve our internal AI assistant and automate tasks such as collecting project updates and drafting reports. With support from the team, test these tools and check that their results accurately reflect the source information Gather feedback through surveys and conversations. Write short guides and help colleagues adopt tools and ways of working that meet their needs Where you belong As a working student you will be part of SAP Next Gen, a global network of students and early professionals growing together. You'll access mentors, development programmes, and peers building careers alongside you. It's a place to start something real. At SAP, AI Foundation develops and operates technology and services that help teams and customers use AI in business applications. Our Central Engineering Services team works across product and engineering teams for AI platform of SAP. We explore technical solutions, build prototypes and help improve software delivery and reliability. Our product management work connects stakeholder needs with technical options and team priorities. You will work closely with product management colleagues, engineers and architects, combining planning and coordination with practical AI tooling. Additional Information Please apply initially with your resume in table form. In a later stage we will ask you to upload also school leaving certificates, certificate of enrollment, current university transcript of records, copies of any academic degrees already earned, and if available, references from former employers (including internships). This is a SAP global, strategic, paid working student position that provides students with opportunities to find purpose in their careers. #Workingstudent #Werkstudent #Germany #Deutschland #Student #SAPGermanStudentsCareers #SAPNextGen About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. description: Job Description This is Allego Allego provides reliable charging solutions to cities, companies, and consumers. We deliver charging facilities that can be used by all electric cars and every EV driver, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero emission mobility and see to it that EV drivers can charge at the right location with the right solution. The EV market is growing and changing rapidly. The road is exciting and with confidence we stay ahead. A Bit More About The Job We are looking for a new team member to join our Network Planning team, which is located in Berlin (DE). The Network Planning team is responsible for determining the right location for the right type of charger to support investment decisions for infrastructure expansion and to reach our goal of clean mobility. In other words: as a Network Development Analyst you help us spot locations where people with EVs are, or potentially would like to charge, based on lots of data. You also support with development of our proprietary Network planning tools. With your analyses you play a pivot role in the investment decisions for expansion of our network. Of course you won’t do this alone. You will be a part of a dynamic international team. They will help you to get up to speed within Allego, but hopefully you can teach them a thing or two yourself, because a fresh pair of eyes always sees new things. The Network Planning team collaborates closely with related departments within Allego like Sales, Finance and Product Development. So you will operate in an international environment with colleagues from all over Europe. Since Allego is one of the main players in this new and growing industry, you will be able to shape the future of transport and build the charging infrastructure of the future! Job Requirements This is you With your excellent analytical skills, you recognize patters in big loads of data, so you can pinpoint ideal locations for EV chargers. You enjoy working with numbers and are always looking for ways to use data to improve results. Your flexibility, optimism and “can-do” attitude fits our fast-paced environment. You are eager to learn, highly self-motivated, and excited to work in the highly innovative and international sector of sustainable mobility! As our ideal candidate: Currently enrolled in an e-mobility, data science, business informatics, economics, or related Master study. You are proficient in Excel (advanced formulas, macros, modelling structures) and are comfortable working with large and complex datasets, including structuring, validating, and translating them into actionable insights. You have experience or interest in market and location analysis, including: Assessing demand drivers (traffic flows, EV adoption, user behaviour) Analyzing competitive landscape and network coverage Translating macro market insights into clear conclusions You have experience working with data using Python. You have affinity towards the EV and charging industry. You are able to independently manage multiple projects simultaneously. Your excellent communication skills enable you to connect and collaborate with multiple internal stakeholders. You are fluent in English, and as we are Pan-EU, you are not afraid of fellow-Europeans. Nice to have: Financial modelling capabilities, including building and maintaining business cases (e.g. cash flow modelling, scenario analysis) Experience with Geodata processing, BI tools and ML techniques. However, don’t worry, hiring is more than just ticking boxes for us! This is our offer Still with us and interested and curious what we offer? First and foremost, we give you: salary! Rent needs to be paid after all. But more interestingly is what we cannot express in money: we offer you a challenging job with responsibilities and real influence, in a fast-paced, goal-oriented environment. At Allego you choose your own challenges, we will make education and training available if necessary, to keep driving forward. Having read all of this and still thinking that this is a great opportunity (then you are probably right), just apply via the link. Hopefully we meet soon.
